zh: 青年運動疑襲利雅德機場 傳數十傷 多家航空停飛
en: Suspected Houthi strike on Riyadh airport; dozens reported hurt; airlines suspend flights

zh: 臺北101國慶展演晚間10時登場，600臺無人機與煙火演出約14分鐘
en: Taipei 101 National Day show began at 10pm, with 600 drones and fireworks over about 14 minutes

zh: 漢莎航空座椅溫控已提供，加拿大航空OLED娛樂投入商用
en: Lufthansa offers seat climate controls; Air Canada’s OLED system is in commercial service.

zh: 達美航空統一A350客艙配置為275座
en: Delta standardizes A350 cabin layout on 275 seats

zh: 華航公告10月16日起開立機票調漲行李相關費用，最高漲幅約3成
en: China Airlines to raise baggage-related fees on tickets issued from Oct 16, by up to about 30%

zh: 臺中雙十國慶升旗典禮，5架無人機垂掛國旗飛過府前廣場。
en: Taichung National Day flag-raising ceremony features five drones carrying flags over plaza.

zh: EASA發布CS-MMEL簡易查閱規則第4版，納入ED Decision 2025/021/R
en: EASA publishes Easy Access Rules for CS-MMEL Issue 4, incorporating ED Decision 2025/021/R

zh: Shield AI稱X-BAT仍瞄準2026年底飛行測試
en: Shield AI says X-BAT remains on track for late-2026 flight testing

zh: 西南航空全國性系統當機 登機門改人工處理旅客
en: Southwest Airlines nationwide system outage; gate agents process passengers manually

zh: IATA呼籲人員、技術與標準協力提升航空安全
en: IATA calls for closer integration of people, technology and standards to improve safety.
